title: Dry Gin with a Squeeze of Lime

text_block_list.text:
One evening, after messing up at work,
I was sitting at the counter of a bar & restaurant, letting out a heavy sigh.
Customer, partake of this.

—An original mocktail inspired by the abyss's breath...
"The Divine Comedy."

...Kukuku...! Haaahahahaha!
Small wonder you are startled, yet I heard your sigh begging for intoxication!

Then allow me to guide you, O wandering lamb!
Let these flames of purgation cleanse all your doubts and sins!
Now, question the order! Cast aside your reason!

For now, I pick up the glass placed before me.
The girl offering the mocktail appears to be a member of the staff here.

Still, I have no idea what she's talking about. As I sit there bewildered...
the bartender watching nearby steps in to rescue me.

text_block_list.name: Bartender
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like she made it for you.
She wants you to drink it so you'll cheer up.

To that faint prayer I hear, allow me to answer—
"Something like that."
If that's the case, I gratefully take a sip. And—

With the sweet and sour notes of citrus accented by rich pomegranate,
it was a refreshing mocktail that brought to mind a seaside vacation.

Naturally!
For it was blended by my own hands!

To conjure intoxication anytime, anywhere. Such is my
potential—the artistry of I, Tanino Gimlet!

text_block_list.name: Bartender
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you supposed to be waiting tables?
How many times do I have to tell you not to make drinks on your own—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, drink it down, burn away everything!
Let your sins be judged, and a new gateway shall be granted unto you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haaahahahahahahaaa~~!

Whether she hears the bartender's scolding or not...
Tanino Gimlet strides off with a booming laugh.

text_block_list.name: Bartender
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry about that, customer. She might look wild, but she's a caring kid.
I bet she just couldn't ignore someone looking so down in the dumps.
choice_data_list: (So that's why she went out of her way...)

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, as I watch Tanino Gimlet faithfully wait tables
while bursting into periodic bouts of loud laughter—

I realize I've completely forgotten about my gloom...
And by the time my glass is empty, my heavy sighs have vanished entirely.

Sometime later, I spotted her on campus.
It turned out Tanino Gimlet was a student at Tracen Academy, and—
(KABOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
......Sin. The secret spice of samsara.
A single drop of garnish capable of rewriting the script of destiny...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A lemon peel for a martini.
A slice of lime for a gin and tonic.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then, for Tanino Gimlet, there is—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet!
How many times must I tell you not to break the fences?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: For Tanino Gimlet—there is destruction.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Are you even listening to me?!
Do you have any idea how much repairs cost?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fret not. It is behind destruction that rebirth truly resides.
Not even the hound of the underworld can halt the hand that wields my hammer.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, fixing it yourself doesn't make it okay!
Earning money for materials isn't easy, you know... Are you listening to me?!

It seemed Tanino Gimlet was a troublemaker
who frequently smashed fences around the school, and—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet! Tanino Gimlet!
...Good grief, so this is where you were! Get back to class this instant!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, tsk, tsk...!
A poor proposal, mademoiselle.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Behold, this celestial light. The contrast woven with darkness.
Silently standing amid dancing dust—a taboo.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Upon the hearts of passersby, this truth shall be engraved...!
—That into this derelict ruin, the bringer of light has descended...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, though God may demand it, I shall not return!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Just get back to class already!
She was also a troublemaker who frequently skipped class for reasons no one understood, and—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Guh, hah, hah, hah!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Haaah, DAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, hah, hah... phew! ...Hmph, not bad.
Yet form holds no meaning unless it is completely ingrained into the flesh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My late kick is still lackluster.
The sharpness of my starting dash still leaves room for improvement—I see.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah! I welcome any ordeal as many times as it takes!
Now, first unto Nemea! And then, to Lerna!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haaahahahahahahaaa!

Yet despite all that, when it came to training, she took it with utmost seriousness...
That was the kind of horsegirl she seemed to be.
